description: This file defines several TypedDict classes related to Lakera AI requests and responses, focusing on data structures for messages, payloads, breakdowns, and developer info.

classes.name: LakeraAIRequest
classes.description: TypedDict for Lakera AI request parameters, including messages, project ID, payload, breakdown, metadata, and dev info.

classes.name: LakeraAIPayloadItem
classes.description: TypedDict representing individual payload items, including start/end positions, text, detector type, and labels.

classes.name: LakeraAIBreakdownItem
classes.description: TypedDict for breakdown details related to the detection process, such as project, policy, detector IDs, and detection status.

classes.name: LakeraAIDevInfo
classes.description: TypedDict containing developer-related metadata such as git revision, timestamp, model version, and overall version.

classes.name: LakeraAIResponse
classes.description: TypedDict for Lakera AI responses, including flags, payloads, breakdowns, and developer info.
